The '''Fotia's Fire launcher''', also known as the '''Fotia's Fire cannon''', was a type of [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]] that fired [[Fotia's Fire]] projectiles, which [[Fire/Legends|burnt]] a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Hull/Legends|hull]]. The [[Tof Kingdom]]'s [[Royal Fortune-class light clipper|''Royal Fortune''-class light clipper]] [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] had one Fotia's Fire launcher amidships.<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Fotia's Fire launcher was introduced in the [[2010]] sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TUR" />
